text: The Chair and the Members of the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place acknowledge, thank and applaud Tess Romain, for her years of service and dedication as a Member to the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place. A crystal clock will be engraved with Tess’s name and years of service to the Board and delivered to her along with a letter conveying the Board’s appreciation. The Members of the Board, Management, and Staff applaud Tess and wish her all the best in her future endeavors.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Requested the Board Chair to send a letter to Tess Romain conveying the Board’s appreciation for her service and dedication on the Board.
